title: Crunchy Irish Potato Cakes with Smoked Salt
description: Irish potato cakes with a crunchy exterior, perfect for a quick snack or side dish.
instructions: Grate the potatoes and onion, and squeeze out excess moisture.
In a bowl, combine the grated potatoes, onion, grill, and flaky sea salt.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the potato mixture into the skillet.
Flatten the mixture slightly and cook for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
Flip the cakes and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes or until crispy and golden.
